RE: Account reference: ACC-738457

Dear Willa Ellis,

Receiving your dispute letter regarding the account ACC-738457, we acknowledge your request to validate the debt. We understand that you have expressed concerns about the accuracy of the debt and its impact on your credit report.

We have reviewed the account information, and we confirm that the original creditor is Meridian Federal Credit Union. The current balance on the account is $742.48. The account was charged off on May 3, 2021, and the last payment was received on July 26, 2023.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), we are required to provide you with validation of the debt. We will send you a written notice with the amount of the debt, the name of the creditor, and a statement that unless you dispute the validity of the debt within 30 days after receiving the notice, we will assume the debt is valid.

Please note that the amount of $2.00 mentioned in your dispute letter does not match the current balance of $742.48 on the account. We will investigate this discrepancy and provide you with a written response.

You have the right to dispute the debt further if you believe it is inaccurate. Please contact us at your earliest convenience to discuss this matter further.

Sincerely,

Vanguard Debt Services
